HELD. Network stalwart: net margin 50.8%, revenue growth 11.3/10.0/11.4%, EPS growth 4.9/17.5/18.3%; pe_ratio 34.7 is full (PEG ~2.4). A rotation question (C20), not a broken story.
HELD, sma_distance_pct -22.87. Still losing money: net margin -19.9%, operating margin -33.1%, FCF yield -7.3%, revenue growth 10.1% after -19.6/-52%. D/E 0.48. C22: PM must confirm the story.

findings.claim: The calendar sits in the Oct-Dec tax-loss window (C23), which Lynch treats as an entry season for depressed names in sound companies. On this list only MP is deeply depressed, and its soundness is unproven. This is context only, not a nomination.
findings.evidence: date 2026-10-23; MP sma_distance_pct -22.87; every other room name sma_distance_pct between 0.45 and 14.63

findings.claim: Several P/B and D/E values cannot be used. WRB P/B 0 and D/E 0, EBC D/E 0 and AUB P/B 0.0011 are source artifacts. ABBV, PRCH, MTCH and CAH have negative P/B and D/E because their equity is negative. MA P/B 97.5 and D/E 4.39 reflect buyback-shrunk equity. None of these carries a balance-sheet read.
findings.evidence: ABBV PB -85.0 DE -11.9; PRCH PB -164.6 DE -34.2; MTCH PB -45.4 DE -15.0; CAH PB -21.1 DE -3.45

findings.claim: The momentum-lane staples are mostly stalwarts and slow growers priced at 27-44x earnings on single-digit sales growth. By C8/C9 arithmetic they are fully valued; upside rests on the trend, not earnings. This is a rotation-discipline point (C20), not a reason to drop anything.
findings.evidence: WMT pe_ratio 43.7; FAST 42.3; WCN 41.5; CHD 34.9; KDP 34.8; ADP 26.7 (revenue growth 1.6-11%)

findings.claim: The names whose fundamentals back the price are TRV, RELY, CRM and M: cheap against growth or strong free cash flow, with clean or manageable debt.
findings.evidence: TRV pe_ratio 10.5 FCF 12.6%; RELY pe_ratio 17.4 rev 29.4%; CRM PEG ~1.1 FCF 7.4%; M pe_ratio 8.7 FCF 23.6%

findings.claim: MP is held and down 22.87% against its average, while the business is still losing money and burning cash. C22 allows buying a 25% drawdown only if the story is verified intact, and served data cannot verify it, so that check goes to the PM. The stop is house law and is not discussed here.
findings.evidence: net_profit_margin -19.9%; operating margin -33.1%; FCF yield -7.3%; revenue growth 10.1/-19.6/-52.0%

findings.claim: V is held and its story is intact, but it is fully priced (PEG ~2.4 on blended EPS growth). Under C20 the question is whether to rotate into a cheaper stalwart, never whether to sell on a target. P/E history is not served, so 'above its own average' cannot be tested.
ESTC's earnings come from below the operating line, so its P/E understates what the business costs.
findings.evidence: operating margin -1.5% vs net margin 20.8%; pe_ratio 27.3

findings.claim: AUB's revenue is growing by acquisition while EPS has fallen three years running. That is the dilution and diworseification pattern (C17/C18).
AEP's FCF yield of 12.6% is atypical for a regulated utility (ETR in the same room shows -6.1%). It may be a source artifact and should be treated with caution.
findings.evidence: AEP FCF yield 12.6%; ETR FCF yield -6.1%

findings.claim: CP reports in CAD and CCEP in EUR. The ratios are currency-neutral, but market cap may be in the reporting currency.

The three automatic fail gates are NOT_TESTABLE, and an untested gate is not a pass. Gate 1 needs bank-vs-funded debt and maturities, gate 2 needs a two-quarter inventory series, gate 3 needs institutional ownership. PEGs above approximate from served 3y growth, not consensus.
findings.evidence: no inventory, cash, debt-kind or ownership fields in packet; reused_from 2026-10-21 on MA MTCH CRBG EW ADP ACA AMGN KDP SHO CAH SN ESTC FAST V MP

not_served: cash and marketable securities / net cash per share (C10, C11)
inventory series, two quarters (C14, fail gate 2)
bank vs funded debt split and maturities (C15, fail gate 1)
capex vs operating cash flow detail (C16)
P/E history (C17, C20 stalwart rotation test)
long-term consensus EPS growth (C8 PEG; 3y served growth used as approximation)
dividend payout ratio (C17 slow grower test)
REIT FFO and asset values at spot (SHO, M asset-play read)
